ingredients.name: SODIUM STARCH GLYCOLATE TYPE A POTATO

name: Primidone
indications_original: Primidone tablets used alone or concomitantly with other anticonvulsants, are indicated in the control of grand mal, psychomotor, and focal epileptic seizures. It may control grand mal seizures refractory to other anticonvulsant therapy.
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Primidone Tablets, USP, 50 mg are supplied as white, round, flat-faced, bevel-edged tablets, debossed
  
“AN” above “44” on one side and cut-bisected on the other side.
 
                  They are available as follows:
                  
                  Bottles of 100: NDC 42291-509-01
                  Bottles of 500: NDC 42291-509-50
                  
                  
                  Primidone Tablets, USP, 250 mg are supplied as white, round, flat-faced, bevel-edged tablets, debossed
  
“AN” bisect “545” on one side and plain on the other side.
 
                  They are available as follows:
                  
                  Bottles of 100: NDC 42291-511-01
                  Bottles of 500: NDC 42291-511-50
adverseReactions_original:
Primidone is contraindicated in:
                  1) patients with porphyria and
                  2) patients who are hypersensitive to phenobarbital
                  (see 
       
 
  
                        CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY
                     ).
